properties.name: A deliberate refutation reads as refuted, never as a contradiction defect to heal
properties.statement:
An opposing CONTRADICTS whose source holds marks its target refuted, and that is a correct state of the record. detect_defects does not report it as a "contradiction" defect, and loop_status does not count it as structural debt. A contradiction between two claims that both hold is still reported.

From the primes trial, item 3 (F22). @ajs, 2026-10-17.
